loomBot.scope: Prepared from Chapter II progress earned after migrating the fixed representative completed-v1 save. Intermediate locations and guard defeats are arranged by the progression test. Preparation only spends earned SP/materials and rests at the real spire camp. Once the Loom battle begins, the bot uses native movement/held attack and legal art, link, evade, tonic, and tea commands; it never edits HP, damage, energy, cooldowns, resonance, enemy state, or position. This is automated rules testing, not human or physical-device play.

crosswinds.scope: Phase threshold and initial party positions arranged. Windups, attack selection, lane creation, and elapsed time use the actual engine update.
